# The command line

<!-- Generated by tools/make_command_line.py from the argument parser in src/mobcal/cli.py and the descriptions in src/mobcal/options.py. Edit those and run the tool; a test fails while this page differs from what it writes. -->

`mobcal` is the program the window runs, typed in a terminal: one command with a subcommand for each task, running calculations, writing an input from a quantum chemistry output, writing the methods paragraph for finished runs, checking and building the programs, and opening the window. `mobcal` runs in any terminal once the installation's folder is on the `PATH`, which the Windows installer offers to do, and in the MOBCAL command prompt of the Windows Start menu either way ([Installing MOBCAL](install.md)). The options of `mobcal run` and `mobcal import` that the window also sets carry the same descriptions as its tooltips, from one table in the package, so the two say the same thing about every setting they share ([The window](window.md)). `mobcal COMMAND -h` prints a command's section of this page.

- [`mobcal version`](#mobcal-version): Print the package version.
- [`mobcal self-check`](#mobcal-self-check): Check that this copy can compute a cross section.
- [`mobcal build`](#mobcal-build): Compile the 2012 Fortran with gfortran.
- [`mobcal run`](#mobcal-run): Run calculations in parallel, one process per run.
- [`mobcal gui`](#mobcal-gui): Open the window.
- [`mobcal methods-text`](#mobcal-methods-text): Print the methods paragraph for runs.
- [`mobcal render-parameters`](#mobcal-render-parameters): Write the element table and the settings the program reads into a directory, for running the program there by hand.
- [`mobcal import`](#mobcal-import): Write an ion file from an ORCA or Gaussian output or an .xyz file, with the charges you name, or from a .mfj, with its own.
- [`mobcal export`](#mobcal-export): Write the .mfj the 2012 program reads from an ion file.

## mobcal version

Print the package version.

```
usage: mobcal version [-h]
```

## mobcal self-check

Check that this copy can compute a cross section.

```
usage: mobcal self-check [-h] [--choline] [--report PATH]
```

- `--choline`: Also run the 2012 choline input in helium and compare it with the 2012 output, about 3 min.
- `--report PATH`: Write the report to this file as well.

## mobcal build

Compile the 2012 Fortran with gfortran.

```
usage: mobcal build [-h] [--gas {he,n2}] [--out DIR]
```

- `--gas {he,n2}`: One gas. Default: both.
- `--out DIR`: The output directory. Default: build/fortran/.

## mobcal run

Run calculations in parallel, one process per run.

```
usage: mobcal run [-h] [--method KEY|PATH] [--seeds N[,N...]] [--rng {philox,ranlux}]
                  [--workers N] [--split W|auto] [--mode {in-order,balanced,throughput}]
                  [--dealing {static,claimed}] [--parameters PATH|NAME] [--out DIR]
                  [--skip-done] [--settings PATH] [--temperature T] [--imp N] [--itn N]
                  [--inp N] [--inum N] [--inor N]
                  INPUT [INPUT ...]
```

- `INPUT`: The ions to run, one calculation for each input and seed. Paths to .mfj files, or globs.
- `--method KEY|PATH`: A preset of the gas, the element table, the random number generator and the six run settings. The methods are 2012-he, the 2012 release's calculation in helium, its element table and settings under RANLUX; 2012-n2, the same in nitrogen; 2012-philox-he, the 2012 helium table and settings under Philox4x32-10; 2012-philox-n2, the same in nitrogen; 2000-he, the 2000 helium release's calculation, its table at 298 K and 25 trajectories per block under RANLUX; or the path of a method file. A table, generator or setting given beside it overrides it, and the run records custom. Default: 2012-philox-he.
- `--seeds N[,N...]`: One run of each ion for every seed; the 2012 seed is 5013489. A list of integers separated by commas. Default: 5013489.
- `--rng {philox,ranlux}`: The random number generator: Philox4x32-10, or RANLUX, the 2012 generator, which reproduces the 2012 outputs at the 2012 seed. Default: the method's, philox under 2012-philox-he.
- `--workers N`: How many runs are in flight at once. Default: the number of processor cores divided by the processes per run, or under `--split` auto, the number it chooses.
- `--split W|auto`: How many processes each calculation is divided among. A divided run gives the serial result exactly. W processes, or auto, which chooses the runs in flight and the processes per run from the run count, the processor cores and the ion sizes, in the mode chosen, dividing a run among at most 40 processes, no more than its slowest block of trajectories lets it use, and only when that saves at least 20% of its time. Default: 1, one process per calculation.
- `--mode {in-order,balanced,throughput}`: How a batch of more runs than fit at once uses the processor cores. Finish in order runs one at a time, divided among every core it can use, so runs complete one after another and a pause waits for the run in flight. Balanced runs as many at once as keeps each divided run at least 70% efficient (its time as one process, over the processes times its divided time): on a 40-core workstation, three choline runs at once in helium and one in nitrogen, and on 8 cores one at a time. Most throughput runs one process per run when there are at least as many runs as cores, which finishes the batch soonest and no run before the first wave ends. The counts are physical cores, not the logical processors hyperthreading doubles, which add a quarter to a third more throughput and make every run take about half as long again. in-order, balanced or throughput; given alone, it implies `--split` auto. Default: balanced.
- `--dealing {static,claimed}`: How a divided calculation shares its blocks of trajectories among its processes. Static gives each process a fixed share. Claimed lets each process take the next block no other has taken, so the processes finish together and one slowed by other work does not set the run's time. The result is the same either way. static or claimed. Default: claimed.
- `--parameters PATH|NAME`: The element table, which gives each atom of the ion its mass and its Lennard-Jones and hard-sphere parameters in the gas: a table the package ships, or a TOML file of one's own for one gas. A path to a table for the method's gas, or a shipped table by name: 2012 (He, N2), 2000 (He). Default: the method's, 2012 under 2012-philox-he.
- `--out DIR`: The folder for a study: each batch adds its run directories here, and summary.csv and summary.json are rewritten to cover every run it holds. Default: runs/.
- `--skip-done`: Leave out the runs the output folder already holds complete.

### Run settings

The temperature and the five sampling counts the 2012 programs compiled in. Without these, every run uses its method's values: the 2012 values (temperature 301 K, imp 1000, itn 10, inp 40, inum 250000, inor 30), or under 2000-he, 298 K and imp 25.

- `--settings PATH`: A settings file (TOML) for every run, which replaces the method's settings; a key it leaves out keeps the 2012 value.
- `--temperature T`: The buffer gas temperature in kelvin, 301 K in 2012 and 298 K in 2000. It sets the trajectory method's velocity grid and the conversion of each cross section to a mobility.
- `--imp N`: Trajectories per block of the trajectory method, one block for each velocity point in each cycle.
- `--itn N`: Cycles of the trajectory method, each an independent estimate of the collision integral, whose standard deviation the output reports.
- `--inp N`: Velocity points of the trajectory method's integration over the relative velocity.
- `--inum N`: Trajectories of the projection-approximation and exact hard-sphere pass, which the helium program alone makes.
- `--inor N`: The most reflections followed per trajectory of the exact hard-sphere pass.

## mobcal gui

Open the window.

```
usage: mobcal gui [-h] [--check]
```

- `--check`: Open the window, close it, and exit 0: a test that it starts.

## mobcal methods-text

A methods paragraph for the completed runs, written from their records: the program and version, method, gas, element table, temperature, trajectory counts, generator and seeds, with the papers to cite. Printed for the run directories, or folders of them, named.

```
usage: mobcal methods-text [-h] PATH [PATH ...]
```

- `PATH`: Run directories, or folders of them.

## mobcal render-parameters

Write the element table and the settings the program reads into a directory, for running the program there by hand.

```
usage: mobcal render-parameters [-h] [--parameters PATH|NAME] [--settings PATH]
                                GAS [DIR]
```

- `GAS`: The gas whose table is written: he or n2.
- `DIR`: Where to write parameters.tab and settings.tab. Default: the current directory.
- `--parameters PATH|NAME`: Write this TOML file, or this shipped table by name (2012 (He, N2), 2000 (He)), instead of the gas's default table.
- `--settings PATH`: Write this settings file instead of the 2012 values.

## mobcal import

Write an ion file from an ORCA or Gaussian output or an .xyz file, with the charges you name, or from a .mfj, with its own.

```
usage: mobcal import [-h] [--charges KEY] [--net-charge Q] [--gas {he,n2,both}]
                     [-o OUT.ion.json] [--force]
                     SOURCE
```

- `SOURCE`: An ORCA or Gaussian output, an .xyz file, or a .mfj (the 2012 layout or MobCal-MPI's nine columns).
- `--charges KEY`: Which atomic charges the imported ion carries: a set the file holds, such as CHELPG or Mulliken, or uniform, the net charge spread evenly over the atoms. The keys are mulliken, lowdin, chelpg and hirshfeld for an ORCA output's blocks; mulliken, hirshfeld, cm5, natural, mk and chelpg for a Gaussian output's; column for an .xyz file's fifth column; and uniform. Without it, the import lists what the file holds.
- `--net-charge Q`: The ion's net charge, in elementary charges. An .xyz file needs it; for an output it must agree with the charge the output was computed at.
- `--gas {he,n2,both}`: Whose element table the atoms must be in. Default: both.
- `-o OUT.ion.json, --out OUT.ion.json`: The ion file to write. Default: SOURCE-STEM_KEY.ion.json in the current directory.
- `--force`: Replace OUT.ion.json if it exists.

## mobcal export

Write the .mfj the 2012 program reads from an ion file.

```
usage: mobcal export [-h] [--gas {he,n2,both}] [--parameters PATH|NAME] [-o OUT.mfj]
                     [--force]
                     ION.ion.json
```

- `ION.ion.json`: The ion file.
- `--gas {he,n2,both}`: Whose element table gives each element its key; with both, each element must be in both tables. Default: both.
- `--parameters PATH|NAME`: This TOML file, or this shipped table by name (2012 (He, N2), 2000 (He)), instead of the gas's default table.
- `-o OUT.mfj, --out OUT.mfj`: The file to write. Default: ION.mfj beside the ion file.
- `--force`: Replace OUT.mfj if it exists.
